shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular-ish slab
repeated ornament arranged along a border/edge
overall symmetry or repetition of a unit
justification: Both slabs bear low-relief ornament in which repeated plant-like or scrolling motifs run along the edges of the field, which is about as generic as decorative correspondence gets. A is dominated by figural narrative content — a mounted/standing figure, a ship with rigging, animals — enclosed by a plaited interlace border on a rounded phallic-shaped stone, whereas B shows only naturalistic long-stemmed flowering plants with radiating petals rising up a plain rectangular panel, with no figures, no interlace and no enclosed picture field.
